描述_EN: the panel is ornamented in relief with two ducks and lotuses on one side, and rock, bamboo, and three cocks on the other; raised border of fishes, aquatic creatures, and weeds on one side, and a vine and squirrel pattern on the other. porcelain with creamy white glaze faintly crackled. table screen, in the form of an oblong panel fitted into a stand. the stand is ornamented with panels of i) prunus and birds, ii) a citron bough birds, and a milled border.
描述_ZN: the panel is ornamented in relief with two ducks and lotuses on one side, and rock, bamboo, and three cocks on the other; raised border of fishes, aquatic creatures, and weeds on one side, and a vine and squirrel pattern on the other. 瓷器，乳白色的釉面上有微弱的裂纹。 台式屏风，以长方形面板的形式安装在一个支架上。 支架上有i)梅花和鸟的面板，ii)香橼树枝的鸟，和磨光的边框。
